title: Ordinary scalar associator fixed by adjunction units
statement: For composable morphisms a:R to S and b:S to T of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of any scheme W, and d:R to T equal to a followed by b, ordinaryScalarAssociator is the unique left-adjoint comparison from successive ordinary scalar extension to direct extension for the unit-normalized pbcScalarAdjunction and identity-on-sections pbcRestrictComp.

Existing exact-derived square pasting, universal left-derived uniqueness, and normalized ordinary/derived scalar adjunctions. No specialized model comparison.

mathlib_searches.query: For exact functors, localization preserves the unit-normalized associator of composite adjunctions and the universal left derived counit comparison.
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.localization, localization_unit_app, localization_counit_app, derived_unit and derived_counit. These supply generic adjunction localization, not the specialized pbc normalization and associator comparison.
